**Solution:** Modified `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts` to use `process.argv` directly instead of relying on the parsed `args` parameter from commander.js. This ensures all arguments and flags (including `--ci`) are correctly passed to the underlying `frai-gate` CLI.
